'''Star Tours Flight 1008''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] and [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. It was on time and set to arrive at the spaceport's Gate 2D at 0845 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 0940.
